content.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `truncate_slug`: it did a raw `text[:limit]` slice, which can land on a hyphen boundary and leave a dangling trailing hyphen (e.g. `"my-report-title"[:10]` → `"my-report-"`). The fix slices then strips any trailing hyphens with `rstrip("-")`, so `truncate_slug("my-report-title", 10)` now returns `"my-report"`. Slugs already under the limit are untouched.

Both tests pass. I left `old_slugify` alone since it's a documented legacy passthrough awaiting migration, not a correctness problem.
